title: 第01章 玄字一号监
slug: 夜天子全本免费-夜天子最新章节列表
content_zh:
说话的人穿着一套淡青色的皂隶服，头上戴着一顶比他的脑袋略显大些的漆布冠，腰间系着一条陈旧的红布织带，脚下则是一双不太合脚的白帮乌面直筒靴，这副打扮，分明就是一个狱卒。
可是，他站在北京城刑部大牢玄字一号监暗无天日的牢房里，对着刚被关进牢房的这些犯官们，语气和神态却谦卑的仿佛“春风得意楼”上招揽生意的小伙计，只是肩上少了一条汗巾。
他很年轻，正是从少年向青年过渡的年纪。身材不高不矮，体形适中，容貌只是中上之姿，但是那双柳叶似的眉毛衬得一双眼睛异常灵动，尤其是他那张唇线明晰、唇形如菱的嘴巴，便使他透出几分唇红齿白的味道来。
他清清浅浅地笑着，温良如处子：“小姓叶，叶小天，三岁时就在天牢里厮混，十六岁那年正式接了我爹的班，成了这玄字一号监的一个守卒。如今已是万历八年，满打满算也当了三年的皇差了，承蒙司狱大人赏识，如今忝为一号监的牢头儿。小天我秉性纯良……”
叶小天自吹自擂地刚说到这儿，一个三十出头的狱卒快步走到他的身边，贴着他的耳朵小声禀报道：“头儿，有人闹事，嫌咱们伙食粗劣，又嫌被褥泛潮，你看……”
叶小天微微侧过头，低声问道：“是哪个不开眼的混蛋，到了咱们这种地方还敢耍横？”
那狱卒小声答道：“是原大理寺右寺丞关云。”
叶小天又问：“摸清他的底细了么？”
那狱卒道：“他贪墨过五万两银子，首辅大人亲自点头抓的人，他的后台也一并抓进来了，没有指望再出去。”
叶小天点点头，微微一扫左右牢房刚刚关入的那些犯官，笑容依旧恬静，那张比许多女孩子唇形还要优美、唇线还要明晰的嘴巴声音小得只有站在他身边的那个狱卒听得见。
“这群生孩子没屁眼的贪官污吏，洪武爷的时候六十两银子就够剥他的皮了，现如今贪污五万两银子，居然还得寸进尺讲这讲那，这天牢是他养老享福的所在么？真是给他脸了。既然他嫌睡炕不舒服，那就把他关到牢尽头空着的那片牢房里给猪一样睡草堆去，一天就给他一个窝头一碗清水，饿不死就行。”
那狱卒担心地道：“头儿，他要真想不开自尽怎么办？”
叶小天嗤笑道：“在这地方还穷讲究的人，舍得死才怪。你不用打他，也不用骂他，就这么晾着吧，什么时候他肯服软了，再罚他倒一个月的马桶，我就不信治不了他！”
那狱卒阴阴一笑，领命而去。
叶小天清咳一声，面朝那些刚刚入狱的诸位犯官，笑容如春风拂面，声音更是温柔可亲：“各位，你们都是起居八座、玉衣锦食的官老爷，就说沦落至此吧，那也都是大贵人，小天会尽心照料，让诸位老爷在我玄字一号监里，有种回家的感觉。”
叶小天说完就向他们笑吟吟地行了一个罗圈揖，那眼神儿一扫，就像角儿台上亮相，只一眼，便把每一位“看官”都照顾到了，这才施施然地举步离开，其神态举止，俨然一位巡视家园的大家长。
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
刑部大牢，俗称天牢。天牢分天地玄黄四监，玄字监看管的都是因为“孔方兄”才入狱的官，大多数都是肥得放屁油裤裆的主儿，是以玄字监在天牢里是也是油水最多的一处地方。
不过，关押官员的地方可不比一般的监牢，今天还是阶下囚的人，很难说明天是否就能官复原职。再者，就算入了狱，做官的人身份也不同于普通囚犯，要是谁想不开自尽了、自残了，狱卒们都要跟着倒霉。
可要一味纵容他们，让他们作威作福，甚至内外勾结，串通消息，做狱卒的尽不到还是要倒霉。是以天牢狱卒最是难做，天牢的牢头儿更是难做，得有十分的手段，才能应付得了这群人精。

叶小天十六岁就接了老爹的差使，成为这玄字一号监的一名狱卒，仅仅三年功夫就当了牢头儿，他的手段可见一斑。

content_en:
The speaker was wearing a set of light cyan uniforms, a varnished cloth crown that was slightly larger than his head, an old red cloth ribbon tied around his waist, and a pair of white black straight boots that didn't fit well. With this look, he was clearly a jailer.
However, when he stood in the dark cell of No. 1 Xuanzi Prison, Dalao, Beijing City Punishment Department, facing the prisoners who had just been put into the cell, his tone and demeanor were as humble as a business boy at the "Chunfeng Deyi Building", except that he was missing a sweat towel on his shoulders.
He is very young, at the age of transition from boyhood to youth. He is neither tall nor short, with a moderate build and an upper-middle-class appearance. However, his willow-leaf-like eyebrows make his eyes extremely lively, especially his mouth with clear lip lines and rhombus-shaped lips, which give him a hint of red lips and white teeth.
He smiled softly and gently, as gentle as a virgin: "My surname is Ye, Ye Xiaotian. He has been hanging out in the sky prison since he was three years old. When he was sixteen, he officially took over my father's class and became a guard in the No. 1 Xuanzi Prison. It is now the eighth year of Wanli, and he has been serving as an imperial emissary for three years. Thanks to the appreciation of the prison chief, he is now the cell leader of the No. 1 Prison. Xiaotian, I have a pure nature..."
Just as Ye Xiaotian finished boasting, a jailer in his early thirties walked up to him quickly and whispered into his ear: "Boss, someone is making trouble. They think our food is poor and our bedding is damp. Look..."
Ye Xiaotian turned his head slightly and asked in a low voice: "Who is this blind bastard who dares to act arrogant in a place like ours?"
The jailer replied in a low voice: "It's Guanyun, the former Prime Minister of the Right Temple of Dali Temple."
Ye Xiaotian asked again: "Have you found out his details?"
The jailer said: "He embezzled more than 50,000 taels of silver. The person who was arrested by the Chief Assistant himself was also arrested by his backstage. There is no hope of getting out again."
Ye Xiaotian nodded and glanced slightly at the prisoners who had just been locked up in the cells on the left and right. His smile was still peaceful, and his mouth, which had a more beautiful shape and clearer lip lines than many girls, spoke so quietly that only the jailer standing next to him could hear it.
"This group of corrupt officials gave birth to children without buttholes. Sixty taels of silver was enough to skin them when Lord Hong Wu was a minister. Now they have embezzled fifty thousand taels of silver and they still have to talk about this and that. This prison is where they can live and enjoy their old age." Where is he? It’s really shameful for him. Since he doesn’t feel comfortable sleeping on the kang, then put him in the empty cell at the end of the cell and let him sleep on a pile of hay like a pig. Give him a bun and a bowl of water every day, as long as he doesn’t starve to death.”
The jailer said worriedly: "Boss, what if he really can't think about it and commits suicide?"
Ye Xiaotian sneered and said: "It's strange that a poor and sophisticated person in this place is willing to die. You don't need to beat him or scold him, just leave him alone. When he is willing to give in, if he is punished by forcing him to empty the toilet for a month, I don't believe that he can't be cured!"
The jailer smiled sinisterly and took the order and left.
Ye Xiaotian coughed, and faced the prisoners who had just been imprisoned, with a smile like the spring breeze on his face, and his voice was even more gentle and friendly: "Everyone, you are all officials who live in eight seats and are well-dressed and well-fed. Let's just say that you have fallen to this. You are also a noble person. Xiaotian will take good care of you and make you feel like you are at home in my Xuanzi No. 1 Prison."
After Ye Xiaotian finished speaking, he bowed his bow to them with a smile. His eyes were as if he were on stage. With just one glance, he took care of every "guest", and then walked away calmly, looking like a patriarch inspecting his home.
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
The prison of the Ministry of Punishment is commonly known as the Tianlao. Tianlao is divided into four prisons: Heaven, Earth, Xuanhuang and Xuanhuang. The guards in Xuanzi prison are all officials who were imprisoned because of "Brother Kong Fang". Most of them are fat masters who fart and wet their crotches. Therefore, Xuanzi prison is in Tianlao.It is also the place with the most oil and water.
However, the place where officials are imprisoned is not like an ordinary prison. It is difficult to say whether those who are still prisoners today will be reinstated tomorrow. Furthermore, even if you are in prison, the status of an official is different from that of an ordinary prisoner. If someone commits suicide or harms himself because of his thoughts, the jailers will be in trouble.
But if you blindly indulge them, let them dominate, and even collude with internal and external parties to collude with information, the jailer will still be in trouble if he fails to do his best. Therefore, it is most difficult to be a jailer in Tianlao, and it is even more difficult to be a cell leader in Tianlao. You must have extraordinary means to deal with this group of people.
Ye Xiaotian took over his father's job at the age of sixteen and became a jailer in Xuanzi Prison No. 1. He became the cell leader in just three years, which shows his methods.
